title: Controlled source packet: domain and evidence brief
excerpt: The forecasting study predicts next-day electricity demand for one campus building. Weather observations recorded after the forecast deadline are unavailable inputs. Occupancy is represented by a published timetable rather than personal tracking. The study does not estimate household electricity use.

title: Controlled source packet: experimental design brief
excerpt: The evaluation will cover 42 consecutive days. A seasonal baseline and a learned forecaster will use the same information cutoff. The final 14 days will be held out from fitting. Forecast errors will be reported for all days, including unusually hot days.
